# Alogliptin

**Authors:** Preeti Patel, Tibb F. Jacobs

**Source:** StatPearls - StatPearls Publishing

## Abstract

Alogliptin, a dipeptidyl peptidase-4 (DPP-4) inhibitor, was approved by the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) to help improve glycemic control in adults with type 2 diabetes (T2D) when used alongside diet and exercise. Alogliptin enhances insulin secretion and reduces glucagon levels by prolonging incretin hormone activity. This drug selectively inhibits DPP-4 without affecting DPP-8 or DPP-9, thereby minimizing off-target toxicity. Alogliptin is available as an oral tablet and is administered once daily. Contraindications include hypersensitivity reactions such as anaphylaxis and angioedema.
